message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9×13‑inch pan) |
|----------|------------|-------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Regular or no‑boil lasagna sheets | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning or dried basil & oregano | 1 tsp each |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | pinch |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | handful |
| | Parmesan cheese, grated (optional) | ¼ cup |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ¼ cup |
| | Fresh parsley, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Bechamel sauce** | Butter | 4 Tbsp |
| | All‑purpose flour | 4 Tbsp |
| | Milk (whole or 2%) | 4 cups (960 ml) |
| | Nutmeg, grated | pinch |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| **Topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2–3 cups (200–300 g) |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |

### Optional extras
- **Spinach** (sautéed, drained) – 2 cups
- **Mushrooms** (sliced, sautéed) – 1 cup
- **Zucchini** (thinly sliced) – 1 cup
- **Red wine** (added to meat sauce) – ½ cup

These ingredients give you a hearty, layered lasagna that’s perfect for family dinners or potlucks. Enjoy!
